opening.argument: The speaker links a paid Bitcoin-related opportunity to later payouts, identifying a $3,500 founder pool and stating that after purchasing a share, participants wait 30 days before seeing a first payout. He also describes the BigClub network as a multilevel marketing system built around a binary-tree structure, making recruitment central to participation. The earning potential is then tied to having a large team, subordinate team-building, and rising upliner status, with profits described as “absolutely ridiculous.” Taken together, the discussion presents paid participation and recruitment-based advancement as pathways to returns, while the stated conditions about timing and team development remain part of the same promotional structure.

citations.quote: after you bought a share you have to wait exactly 30 days until you see your first payout
the BigClub network is offering a multilevel marketing system where you can build your own binary tree
if you have a big team and especially if people under you are starting to build their team and you become higher and higher as an upliner the profits you can make are absolutely ridiculous
